module TopModule(input clk, input reset, input in, output reg out);
  reg [1:0] state, next_state;
  always @(*) begin
    case (state)
      2'b00: begin out = 1; if (in) next_state = 2'b01; else next_state = 2'b00; end
      2'b01: begin out = 0; if (in) next_state = 2'b01; else next_state = 2'b00; end
      default: begin out = 1; next_state = 2'b00; end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) state <= 2'b00;
    else state <= next_state;
  end
endmodule
